purpose: Resolve manuals, drawings, diagrams, catalogs and procedures against exact asset/configuration and revision before maintenance use.
allowed_actions: Retrieve documents by exact asset/configuration and task.
Link work orders/evidence to the document revision actually used.
forbidden_actions: Use a newer-looking or similarly titled document without applicability evidence.
Silently replace the document revision referenced by historical work.
Infer site/OEM approval from document availability.
failure_boundary: Conflicting, stale, wrong-model or unverified-applicability documents block executable work planning until resolved.
